fact: In November 2024 the ministry plan was reported as civil e-litigation in force since August 2020, in 64 courts by end 2023, with the civil court digitisation programme in 37 courts by end 2023 and economic courts fully remote from filing to judgment.
title: تطوير مستمر في أجهزة الوزارة لتسهيل وإنجاز العدالة بالمنظومة القضائية
